hypothesis: Reproduce the exact final maker on the same v2 tape; not an independent statistical sample
limitations: Public tape PnL is not private-round PnL or final z-score.
The caller declares round/data provenance; filenames do not identify the instrument.
Local preflight is not the server's complete static validator.
Timeout/thread settings are not an OS sandbox or memory certification.
reject_if: Any PnL, fill or inventory discrepancy invalidates exact reproducibility
